stories.title: User Login with Valid Credentials
stories.story: As a registered user, I want to log in with my email and password, so that I can access my account and use the application features.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the login page
acceptance_criteria.when: I enter valid email 'user@example.com' and password 'User123!'
acceptance_criteria.then: I should be redirected to the dashboard and see a welcome message

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the login page
acceptance_criteria.when: I enter valid credentials and click the login button
acceptance_criteria.then: My session should be persisted and I should remain logged in on page refresh

stories.title: User Login with Invalid Credentials
stories.story: As a user, I want to see clear error messages when I enter incorrect login credentials, so that I understand why I cannot access my account.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the login page
acceptance_criteria.when: I enter an invalid email format like 'notanemail'
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see an error message 'Please enter a valid email address'

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the login page
acceptance_criteria.when: I enter a valid email but incorrect password
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see an error message 'Invalid email or password'

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the login page
acceptance_criteria.when: I leave the email or password field empty and click login
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see validation errors indicating required fields

stories.title: User Logout
stories.story: As a logged-in user, I want to log out of my account, so that I can secure my session when I'm done using the application.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in and on any page
acceptance_criteria.when: I click the logout button
acceptance_criteria.then: I should be redirected to the login page and my session should be cleared

acceptance_criteria.given: I have logged out
acceptance_criteria.when: I try to access a protected page directly via URL
acceptance_criteria.then: I should be redirected to the login page

stories.title: View User List
stories.story: As an admin, I want to view a list of all users in the system, so that I can manage user accounts effectively.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in as an admin
acceptance_criteria.when: I navigate to the User Management page
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see a table displaying all users with their name, email, and role

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the User Management page
acceptance_criteria.when: There are more than 10 users
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see pagination controls to navigate through the user list

stories.title: Create New User
stories.story: As an admin, I want to create new user accounts, so that I can onboard new team members to the system.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the User Management page
acceptance_criteria.when: I click the 'Add User' button and fill in name, email, password, and role
acceptance_criteria.then: A new user should be created and appear in the user list

acceptance_criteria.given: I am creating a new user
acceptance_criteria.when: I enter an email that already exists in the system
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see an error message 'Email already exists'

acceptance_criteria.given: I am creating a new user
acceptance_criteria.when: I enter a password that doesn't meet security requirements
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see an error message indicating password requirements

stories.title: Edit Existing User
stories.story: As an admin, I want to edit user information, so that I can update user details and roles as needed.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the User Management page
acceptance_criteria.when: I click the edit button for a user and modify their name or role
acceptance_criteria.then: The user's information should be updated and reflected in the user list

acceptance_criteria.given: I am editing a user
acceptance_criteria.when: I change the email to one that already exists
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see an error message preventing the duplicate email

stories.title: Delete User
stories.story: As an admin, I want to delete user accounts, so that I can remove users who no longer need access to the system.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the User Management page
acceptance_criteria.when: I click the delete button for a user
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see a confirmation dialog asking me to confirm the deletion

acceptance_criteria.given: I see the delete confirmation dialog
acceptance_criteria.when: I confirm the deletion
acceptance_criteria.then: The user should be removed from the system and no longer appear in the user list

acceptance_criteria.given: I see the delete confirmation dialog
acceptance_criteria.when: I cancel the deletion
acceptance_criteria.then: The user should remain in the system unchanged

stories.title: Role-Based Access Control
stories.story: As a regular user, I want to be restricted from accessing admin features, so that the system maintains proper security and access control.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in as a regular user (not admin)
acceptance_criteria.when: I try to access the User Management page
acceptance_criteria.then: I should either not see the navigation link or be redirected with an access denied message

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in as a viewer role
acceptance_criteria.when: I access the User Management page
acceptance_criteria.then: I should only see the user list without edit or delete buttons

stories.title: View Personalized Dashboard
stories.story: As a logged-in user, I want to see a personalized dashboard with my statistics and recent activity, so that I can quickly understand my account status.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: I navigate to the dashboard
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see my name, role, and personalized statistics

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the dashboard
acceptance_criteria.when: The page loads
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see quick navigation cards to other modules like Profile, Settings, and User Management (if admin)

stories.title: Role-Based Dashboard Content
stories.story: As a user, I want to see dashboard content appropriate to my role, so that I only see information and actions relevant to my permissions.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in as an admin
acceptance_criteria.when: I view the dashboard
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see admin-specific statistics and a link to User Management

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in as a regular user
acceptance_criteria.when: I view the dashboard
acceptance_criteria.then: I should not see admin-specific content or User Management links

stories.title: View and Edit Profile Information
stories.story: As a user, I want to view and edit my profile information, so that I can keep my account details up to date.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: I navigate to the Profile page
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see my current name, email, and role displayed

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the Profile page
acceptance_criteria.when: I click the edit button and modify my name
acceptance_criteria.then: My name should be updated and reflected throughout the application

acceptance_criteria.given: I am editing my profile
acceptance_criteria.when: I try to change my email to an invalid format
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see a validation error preventing the update

stories.title: Change Password
stories.story: As a user, I want to change my password, so that I can maintain the security of my account.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the Profile page
acceptance_criteria.when: I enter my current password, new password, and confirm new password
acceptance_criteria.then: My password should be updated and I should see a success message

acceptance_criteria.given: I am changing my password
acceptance_criteria.when: I enter an incorrect current password
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see an error message 'Current password is incorrect'

acceptance_criteria.given: I am changing my password
acceptance_criteria.when: The new password and confirm password fields don't match
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see an error message 'Passwords do not match'

acceptance_criteria.given: I am changing my password
acceptance_criteria.when: The new password doesn't meet security requirements
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see an error message indicating the password requirements

stories.title: Manage Notification Preferences
stories.story: As a user, I want to manage my notification preferences, so that I can control what notifications I receive.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the Settings page
acceptance_criteria.when: I view the notification preferences section
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see toggles for different notification types (email, push, in-app)

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the Settings page
acceptance_criteria.when: I toggle a notification preference and save
acceptance_criteria.then: My preference should be saved and reflected when I return to the page

stories.title: Manage Display Preferences
stories.story: As a user, I want to customize my display preferences like theme and language, so that I can personalize my experience.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the Settings page
acceptance_criteria.when: I change the theme from light to dark
acceptance_criteria.then: The application theme should update immediately to reflect my choice

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the Settings page
acceptance_criteria.when: I change the language preference
acceptance_criteria.then: My preference should be saved for future sessions

stories.title: Account Management Options
stories.story: As a user, I want to access account management options like deactivating my account or exporting my data, so that I have control over my account.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the Settings page
acceptance_criteria.when: I view the account management section
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see options for deactivating account and exporting data

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the Settings page
acceptance_criteria.when: I click the deactivate account button
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see a confirmation dialog warning me about the consequences

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the Settings page
acceptance_criteria.when: I click the export data button
acceptance_criteria.then: I should receive a download of my account data in JSON format

stories.title: Session Timeout and Re-authentication
stories.story: As a user, I want my session to timeout after a period of inactivity, so that my account remains secure if I forget to log out.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in and inactive for 30 minutes
acceptance_criteria.when: I try to perform an action
acceptance_criteria.then: I should be redirected to the login page with a message indicating session timeout

acceptance_criteria.given: My session has timed out
acceptance_criteria.when: I log in again
acceptance_criteria.then: I should be redirected to the page I was trying to access

stories.title: Search and Filter Users
stories.story: As an admin, I want to search and filter the user list, so that I can quickly find specific users.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the User Management page with multiple users
acceptance_criteria.when: I enter a search term in the search box
acceptance_criteria.then: The user list should filter to show only users matching the search term in name or email

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the User Management page
acceptance_criteria.when: I select a role filter (Admin, User, Viewer)
acceptance_criteria.then: The user list should show only users with the selected role

acceptance_criteria.given: I have applied search and filters
acceptance_criteria.when: I clear the filters
acceptance_criteria.then: The full user list should be displayed again

stories.title: Profile Picture Upload
stories.story: As a user, I want to upload a profile picture, so that I can personalize my account.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the Profile page
acceptance_criteria.when: I click the upload picture button and select an image file
acceptance_criteria.then: My profile picture should be updated and displayed throughout the application

acceptance_criteria.given: I am uploading a profile picture
acceptance_criteria.when: I select a file that is not an image (e.g., PDF)
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see an error message 'Please upload a valid image file'

acceptance_criteria.given: I am uploading a profile picture
acceptance_criteria.when: I select an image larger than 5MB
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see an error message 'Image size must be less than 5MB'
